description: Retrieves detailed information (e.g., top values, counts) for a specific tag key on an existing Sentry issue; results are paginated (max 1000 values per page).

environment.description: Optional list of environment names to filter tag values; if omitted, all environments are considered.
environment.title: Environment

issue_id.description: The unique numerical ID of the Sentry issue.
issue_id.title: Issue Id

key.description: The specific tag key (e.g., 'browser', 'os', 'environment', 'release', custom tags) for which to retrieve detailed values; case-sensitive.
key.title: Key

name: retrieve_issue_tag_details

data.description: Structured tag details including key, name, counts, and top values with their statistics.
data.title: Data

TagDetails.description: Schema for tag details returned by the API.

name.description: Human-readable display name for the tag.
name.title: Name

topValues.description: List of the most frequent tag values, ordered by count (descending). Limited to top 1000 values.
topValues.title: Top Values

totalValues.description: Total number of tag value occurrences (including duplicates).
totalValues.title: Total Values

uniqueValues.description: Number of unique values for this tag across the issue.
uniqueValues.title: Unique Values

TagDetails.title: TagDetails

TagValue.description: Schema for individual tag value entries in topValues list.

count.description: Number of times this value appears in the issue.
count.title: Count

firstSeen.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this tag value was first seen.
firstSeen.title: First Seen

lastSeen.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this tag value was last seen.
lastSeen.title: Last Seen

name.description: Display name for this specific tag value (may be null for empty/unset values).
name.title: Name

value.description: The actual tag value (may be null for empty/unset values).
value.title: Value

TagValue.title: TagValue
